title: Port the approved iPhone timer design
outcome: Port the approved iPhone timer design.

included: The Track screen adopts the approved warm light and navy dark visual language with clear exact elapsed time, project selection and primary timer controls.
Existing command handlers, busy and conflict states, navigation, accessibility identifiers and Dynamic Type behavior remain available.
excluded: Persistence, wire contracts, signing and version allocation.
